recovery.meaning: Clean pinned MoErgo firmware with the exact Ralf Custom Swiss v8 keymap; it preserves the bootloader and settings partition.

changes: Use a BLE notification for right-half acknowledgements.
Make interaction entry, exit, and cell events atomic with lease expiry.
Reject ordinary split-fragment submission after 500 ms and controller completion after the one-second relative-lease reserve.
Keep transparent clear scenes eligible after queue delay.
Clear a stale local overlay when electrical limits reject a new scene.
Preserve the original Magic tap and hold behavior; Magic + 1 arms one Control action so all 80 keys remain individually actionable.
Pulse one low-brightness left indicator while Control is armed, exit after one key release, and auto-cancel after five seconds.
Latch the first pressed cell so overlapping keys cannot invoke multiple one-shot actions, and synthesize a matching release for a five-second hold.

knownUncertainty.rightAcknowledgement: The notification fix compiles against pinned Zephyr and the host polls boundedly, but actual right-half acknowledgement still requires post-flash hardware proof.
knownUncertainty.splitTiming: The submit and controller-completion deadlines are pragmatic bounds, not proof of remote application time; the right applies scenes on its own work queue. Hardware timing remains required.
knownUncertainty.interactionIndicator: Physical cell 29 is the intended Magic key and maps to raw left LED channel 39 in the current topology; physical calibration must still confirm the topology.
knownUncertainty.rightLedOrder: Physical cell 40 rendered on F6 during alpha1 testing; complete right-side order still requires host-side calibration.
knownUncertainty.transport: Runtime control is intentionally USB-only in protocol v2; BLE typing remains stock.
